spec.headline: 19 five-stars to undo [[one bad day.]]
spec.body: 5-stars needed = (target × reviews − total stars) ÷ (5 − target). Round up.

caption:
Every "Google review calculator" online runs one formula:

New 5-stars needed ≥ (T × N − S) ÷ (5 − T)
T = rating you want, N = reviews you have, S = total stars. Round up.

Example: 49 stars across 11 reviews (showing 4.5). Getting back to 4.8 takes 19 five-star reviews.
